description: Ingest Sage Intacct AR Invoices (the ARINVOICE object) via the legacy XML Web Services readByQuery function and return a pandas DataFrame.

outputs.description: DataFrame of AR Invoice records (one row per ARINVOICE record)

asset_name.label: Asset Name
asset_name.description: Name of the asset to create

resource_name.label: Resource Name
resource_name.description: Key of the SageIntacctResource this asset depends on for authentication

object_name.label: Object Name
object_name.description: Intacct object to query. Defaults to ARINVOICE (AR Invoices).

fields.label: Fields
fields.description: Fields to select from the object. Defaults to a standard ARINVOICE field set if unset.

date_field.label: Date Field
date_field.description: Intacct date field used for from_date/to_date range filtering (e.g. 'WHENCREATED', 'WHENPOSTED', 'WHENDUE').

from_date.label: From Date
from_date.description: Start of the date window (ISO-8601 date, e.g. '2026-06-01'). Converted to Intacct's MM/DD/YYYY format. Required unless a time-based partition_type is set.

to_date.label: To Date
to_date.description: End of the date window (ISO-8601 date, e.g. '2026-07-01'). Converted to Intacct's MM/DD/YYYY format. Required unless a time-based partition_type is set.

extra_query.label: Extra Query
extra_query.description: Additional Intacct query where-clause fragment, ANDed with the date range (e.g. "STATE = 'Open'").

pagesize.label: Page Size
pagesize.description: Records per readByQuery/readMore page (Intacct max is 2000)

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of records to fetch across all pages

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — team names (team:finance) or email addresses.

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds shown in the Dagster catalog. Defaults to ['sage_intacct', 'python'].

include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview Metadata
include_preview_metadata.description: Include sample data preview in metadata

preview_rows.label: Preview Rows
preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata

deps.label: Deps
deps.description: Lineage-only upstream asset keys (no data passed at runtime)

partition_start.label: Partition Start
partition_start.description: Partition start date in ISO format, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based partition types.

partition_values.label: Partition Values
partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'us,eu,asia'.

partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions
partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.

name: Sage Intacct AR Invoices Ingestion
